defaults.reader: Someone involved in this engagement who was not in the planning conversation
defaults.job: Understand the plan well enough to act on their part of it
precisionLocks: locations and how to reach them
rules the reader is bound by

surfaces.name: client-brief
surfaces.reader: The client, reading once on a phone the night before, with no preparation and no vocabulary from this trade
surfaces.job: Know where to be, when to be there, what to bring, and what will happen — well enough to show up prepared without asking a follow-up question
precisionLocks: meeting locations and how to reach them
anything the reader must bring, wear, or do beforehand
rules the reader is personally bound by, including access hours and site restrictions
who to contact and how, if plans change

denyTerms.reason: Trade shorthand the client has no reason to know
denyTerms.replacement: the first hour of soft morning light

denyTerms.reason: Turns the person reading into an object of the process
Procurement vocabulary in a document meant to feel like an invitation
Hides the rule the reader is actually bound by

surfaces.name: operator-playbook
surfaces.reader: The operator on site, mid-engagement, glancing at this between tasks with no time to reconstruct reasoning
surfaces.job: Execute the plan in order, and tell at a glance which regulatory and equipment claims were checked against a source and which are still assumptions
assumedKnowledge: The full working vocabulary of this trade
The equipment named in the plan and its ordinary operation
precisionLocks: locations, access points, and how to move between them
fees, permit thresholds, insurance minimums, and application lead times — each with its source and the date it was checked
access hours and site rules — each with its source and the date it was checked
device settings and menu paths, worded exactly as the device labels them
the verification status of every regulatory claim

denyTerms.reason: Reads as checked when nothing was pulled; the operator acts on it and carries the risk
Same failure as verified, one synonym further from the source
An assumption wearing the clothes of a finding
denyTerms.replacement: the rule and where it is published, or an explicit unverified

denyTerms.reason: Appeals to a consensus with no source behind it
denyTerms.replacement: the specific rule, source, and check date

denyTerms.reason: Generalizes past the one site or device the plan actually covers
denyTerms.replacement: what this site or device specifies
